title: Store-and-forward pruning strategies
description: What a module does when its store-and-forward buffer is full. A module spec declares the strategies it supports; the hub admin chooses one. Whatever the strategy, every loss is counted and shown, and the audit class is never pruned (owner, 2026-11-19, FB-153; amends T-6).

entries.description: The oldest records go first, so the newest picture of the process is always kept.
The lowest-priority data class is pruned first, oldest first within it; audit never.
